Name: Lnh's Community center item output points
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]这是一个自定义地图mod，里面会刷新所有社区中心献祭的物品，详情请看展示图片
This is custom maps mod that will refresh all items offered by community centers. Please refer to the display image for details

入口有2个，如果你安装了[/color][/size][color=#00ffff][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17961]农场便捷站[/url] ，那么入口就在农场便捷站的地图里，有一棵大树，点击即可进入，如果没有安装农场便捷站，那么入口会出现在边远森林，农场上方的地图中，也是一颗大树。
[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]There are 2 entrances，[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]If you install the [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17961]Farms Convenient Road[/url] , [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]So the entrance is on the map of the [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]Farms Convenient Road, [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]There is a big tree, click to enter. [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]If there is no Farms Convenient Road installed, the entrance will appear in the backwoods, [/size][/color][size=4][color=#00ffff]You will also see a big tree.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]兼容SVE，RSV，如果你发现和某个mod不兼容，请告诉我。
Compatible with SVE and RSV. If you find it incompatible with a mod, please let me know.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]如果你喜欢它，可以点个赞吗？非常感谢
If you like it, can you endorse it? Thank you!

b站：[url=https://space.bilibili.com/378625642?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]LiuNianHui_Lnh
[/url]交流群：714558944
如果你喜欢我的mod，可以[url=https://afdian.com/a/420817996Lnh]请我喝杯咖啡[/url]﻿吗？
If you like my mod, can you [url=https://ko-fi.com/liunianhui]buy me a cup of coffee[/url]﻿﻿?[/color][/size]
